meta.scope: offline static; no module loaded, no radio contacted
meta.method: R_MIPS_HI16 (5) + R_MIPS_LO16 (6) relocation pairs from .rel.text give rodata_offset = (hi<<16)+sign16(lo) bound to a symbol index, so the referencing instruction is identified unambiguously

gaps: the enclosing function is the nearest prologue; a literal referenced from a data table rather than code has sites inside whichever function emitted it
reaching a 253A slot means the containing function dispatches through the HAL vtable, not that this knob is the argument
only the first .text site is used for attribution; multiple sites are recorded but not each resolved
